axes.origin: bottom centre of the box (ground contact); every face of a size is modelled in this one frame

hero.description: long side panel on the -Y (glTF +Z) side with its share of corner posts, castings and rails; the opposite side is this model turned 180 degrees about the vertical axis; 20 ft boxes also have forklift pockets
hero.uv0: face 0..1: sides and roof u along +X (roof v along the width), ends u along the width; v = height / box height on sides and ends
hero.uv1: metres / 0.5: repeating detail normal and ORM maps; rust, dents and scuffs are driven per box by the wear seed in the renderer

textures.orm: hero_orm 256x256: R wear mask, G roughness variation, B metal 0

nodes.name: LOD0
nodes.description: the only level: hero detail for faces within about 15 m

nodes.name: paint
nodes.description: tinted surface: corrugated panel, castings, posts and rails; base colour is white so livery colour and colour-by tint multiply it

nodes.name: dark
nodes.description: fixed black rubber and openings: door gaskets, casting apertures, forklift pocket openings

provenance.fact: corner casting envelope 178 x 162 x 118 mm
47 corrugation ribs at 0.252 m pitch, 0.038 m deep (roof 0.016 m)
provenance.source: real pitch is about 0.25 m; depth and rib profile as the LOD0 box

provenance.fact: door furniture: gaskets, locking bars with guides, cam keepers, handles, 4 hinges (5 on high cube) per leaf
forklift pockets 355 x 115 mm, 2.05 m apart, 20 ft only
